FIXED rather than banked, superseding the bank at 60d0d6e7de1d. That bank was argued on provenance -- the reference arrived when account_accountant folded into account (78af90f11075), so it lived in a module carrying no config_in_addons floor and nothing had ever counted it: newly visible, not a new offender. That reasoning is right and decides whether it is somebody regression, not whether it has a destination. It had one. tools.config["limit_time_real_cron"] is odoo.service.get_cron_real_time_budget(), and the raw read was also WRONG: the option defaults to -1 meaning "inherit --limit-time-real" (120), so the expression fell to its 180 fallback and the reconcile cron budgeted itself 50% longer than the server request limit. Fixed in 52f4b954afb6, measured from inside a detached worktree at that commit, banked here separately because an exact gate fails on a decrease and the floor must not describe a tree that does not exist yet.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

ONE NEWLY VISIBLE REFERENCE, NOT A NEW OFFENDER. Was 99, red at 100 since c65b67c822e7 while ratchet.py --list called it clean, because the stamp resolves (CLAUDE.md §4). The one read is tools.config["limit_time_real_cron"] in account/models/account_bank_statement_line_auto_match.py, and that file arrived in 78af90f11075, "account_accountant folds into account, because the split was a licence and not an architecture". It lived in an enterprise module, which carries no config_in_addons floor, so nothing ever counted it -- the same shape as the four iot findings in the same day fieldhooks repair. THE DELTA COULD NOT SAY THIS AND THE SET DIFF COULD: the raw diff between the stamp and HEAD is 10 added / 9 removed, of which nine pair up as the SAME references at shifted line numbers, leaving exactly one. Banked rather than fixed because this gate has nowhere to send it: its own docstring says the core moved to typed frozen snapshots (PoolSettings, HttpSettings, ServerSettings) while "addon code is the other half of the population and is not migrated". A cron bounding its runtime by limit_time_real_cron has no addon-facing API to read instead, and deleting the read changes behaviour. Its sibling in the same survey, werkzeug_in_addons, DID have a destination -- odoo.http re-exports the HTTP exceptions -- and was fixed instead, in 7dc5d3f908ec, floor unmoved at 112. A fix where one exists, a floor where one does not. Measured and banked in a detached worktree at 7dc5d3f908ec; the shared checkout carries other sessions uncommitted work inside addons/, this gate scan scope.
